seo_article_outline.source_summary_for_editor: What if you could ask your AI assistant how any app works and get a real answer, backed by evidence, without ever seeing the source code? You use an app, tap a feature, and wonder how it was built. Maybe it is a fast search bar, a clever clipboard trick, or a mechanic in an old game. Until recently, finding out meant months of learning disassemblers and reading assembly code. A new open-source project called REA changes that. It has earned more than 430,000 stars on GitHub, and in this guide I will explain what it does, which problems it solves, and how you can start using it today. In this guide The problem with reverse engineering How REA solves it How REA works What REA can analyze Real examples How to get started REA at a glance Using REA responsibly Frequently asked questions The Problem: Reverse Engineering Is Hard Reverse engineering is the practice of studying finished software to understand how it works.
